Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

1. The station is situated at very remote location and demography of this area is peculiar and different from main land. This station is located at remote island which is approximately 274 Kms from Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair). Sellers must exercise cautions for quo ting rates as transportation facility to this Island is ver y limited from Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair). 2. Being a tribal area, it is mandatory to get the tribal passes issued by the Civil Administration i.e. DC Office Port Blair (Sri Vijaya Puram) to visit this Island. Hen ce, sellers are requested to make necessary arrangements before proceeding t o this place. All expenses to be borne by the sellers only. 3. Bidder has to upload signed & stamped copy of ATC (Technical Specification) as acceptance of bid terms and conditions. 4. No resource and no local market due to tribal island. 5. Vendor has to upload specific document in specific window i.e. in past perfor mance tab, only upload past performance, kindly don’t upload generic docume nt, failing which your bid will not be considered. 6. Painting of equipment is to be carried out by seller at buyer’s location i.e. Air Force Station Carnicobar, Dist.- Nicobar, Andaman & Nicobar Islands-744301. 7. Vendor to update the tech specs and item details of the paint which will be su pplied. Only ISI marked and reputed brands are to be quoted. Firms not providin g this will be rejected. 8. Vendor to visit the buyer location at their own expenses for exact measurem ent and type of works to be carried out. Telephonic means can also be explored. 9. Necessary equipment for carrying out painting service shall be under scope o f service provider. 10. Before commencement of the job, the paints that will be used by the service provider shall be submitted to Officer In-Charge or competent Buyer’s authority for approval. 11. All tools, tackles, machines, plants and all other equipment’s relevant to the

work including brooms, scavengers, blowers etc. shall be arranged by the Servic e Provider and cost with respect to the same shall be borne by Service Provider alone. 12. The Service Provider has to transport his material/accessories, equipment’s and other tools etc. on his own cost. The to and fro transportation will be at Ser vice Provider’s risk and cost. 13. Materials shall be delivered to the site in original sealed containers, bearing brand name, manufacturer's name and color shade, with labels intact and seals unbroken. It is desired that materials of one manufacturer only shall be used as far as possible and paint of one shade is obtained from the same manufacturing batch. 14. Before proceeding for painting, the surface(s) to be painted are to be scratc hed and cleaned thoroughly for application of base. 15. Service Provider shall ensure that the work is carried out in accordance with specifications and drawings (if any) given by the buyer. 16 The Service Provider must provide complete guarantee for the period of 12 months from the date of completion of work for each painted item. If any defect is found within this guarantee period, the same has to be rectified by the servic e provider at his own cost. . 4.
